explanation: Etymology comes from Greek etymon, the true sense of a word. Entomology, the study of insects, comes instead from entomon, an insect, so the two are easy to mix up.

claims.text: An etymologist studies the origins and history of words.
Entomologists study insects, ornithologists study birds and epidemiologists study the spread of disease.
Etymology comes from Greek etymon, the true sense of a word.
Entomology comes from Greek entomon, insect.
